name: Somalia
description: Somalia from the land of Punt and the coastal sultanates to Italian and British rule, independence in 1960, Siad Barre, civil war and rebuilding.

checkpoints.name: Punt and the sultanates
checkpoints.note: The Laas Geel paintings are thousands of years old. Mogadishu grew as a port of trade, and sultanates ruled the coast.

checkpoints.name: Colonial rule
checkpoints.note: Britain took the north and Italy the south. The Dervishes fought the British until 1920.

checkpoints.name: Independent Somalia
checkpoints.note: The two parts joined in independence in 1960. Siad Barre ruled from 1969.

checkpoints.name: War and rebuilding
checkpoints.note: The state collapsed in 1991. Civil war, famine and al-Shabaab followed, and a federal government has slowly rebuilt.
